notes: dna_partner_of is catalogued functional and symmetric, so Func(dna_partner_of) holds as an axiom: before the delete adenine's partner is thymine, so adenine does not pair with adenine (q0); after the delete nothing says either way. The nucleoside of a base is encoded as the base being part_of its nucleoside (no catalogued relation for it). Pyrimidine is a class.

bridge_refs.thymidine_of_thymine: The deoxyribonucleoside of thymine is thymidine.
